capability.summary: Return up to a requested number of current Git history entries as commit, author, ISO date, and subject objects
capability.description: Runs a fixed `git log` format in an optional repository defaulting to `.` and parses unit-separator-delimited lines into JSON objects. The count defaults to 20 and any non-digit count silently falls back to 20.
capability.problem_space: Structured summary of a bounded prefix of the current repository history; not arbitrary pretty formatting, patch or graph output, revision-range querying, branch mutation, or full commit-object inspection.

constraint.io_signature: Input: optional repo_path defaulting to `.` and optional digit-string count defaulting/falling back to `20`; output: JSON with parsed commit/author/date/subject log entries.
accepted_inputs: an existing local Git repository directory path or omission for the current directory
an optional non-negative digit string passed to `git log -n`; non-digit text silently uses 20
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "git", repo: string, count: integer, logs: object[]}, where each log object is {commit: string, author: string, date: string, subject: string}; count is the number actually parsed, not the requested value. Non-existing repo: {status: "error", message: string} and exit 2. Nonzero Git result: {status: "error", tool: "git", message: string} and exit 1. Missing Git executable, 30-second timeout, or other subprocess exceptions are uncaught and may produce a traceback instead of JSON.
limitations: uses the repository's default current-history traversal with no revision, branch, path, author, date-range, merge, graph, or ordering controls
returns only full commit hash, author display name, ISO date text, and subject; bodies, emails, parents, signatures, refs, stats, and patches are omitted
non-digit count values silently become 20, while digit strings including `0` are passed directly to Git
uses a fixed 30-second timeout, applies no additional output truncation beyond `-n count`, and does not catch timeout or executable-not-found exceptions

output_contract.description: JSON report containing a bounded list of current-history entries with commit hash, author name, ISO date text, and subject.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: get recent Git commits as structured JSON
inspect commit hashes authors dates and subjects
negative_intents: request a custom Git pretty format or raw text log
inspect commit patches, bodies, stats, graph, or signatures
create, amend, revert, reset, or otherwise mutate Git history
